english.meaning: counts pots of hotpot or soup
english.note: 一人一鍋 means one pot each.

exampleSentences.english: Not this afternoon—let’s do individual hot pots tonight. Sound good?
exampleSentences.traditional: 晏晝冇啊，今晚我哋去一人一鍋啊，正唔正？
